items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: That’s why I knew every standard in the world up until the 1950s. Anything like that, Duke Ellington “Take the A Train,” Count Basie like, oh I mean every tune you could think of

ctx.x: But when you say a dance band, at that time, what would the repertoire have included?

Okay it would be like all the standards. That’s why I knew every standard in the world up until the 1950s. Anything like that, Duke Ellington “Take the A Train,” Count Basie like, oh I mean every tune you could think of, the music of the forties basically.
